༄༅/ /zab lam ni gu chos drug gi gzhung khrid ma mo'i lhan thabs kha skong bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam ni gu chos drug gi gzhung khrid ma mo'i

lhan thabs kha skong bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i zhal gdams so/ /chos drug stan thog gcig ma dang*/ /gzhung khrid rgyas pa'i zhal gdams yod/ /rin chen 'od kyi phreng ba dang*/ /dri med 'od kyi phreng ba dang*/ /nyams myong yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ /sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma ste/ /bsre ba'i zab khrid rnam bzhi yod/ /de ltar sde tshan drug po 'di/ /chos drug mkhan la dgos nges yin/ /ces so/ /zab lam chos drug stan thog gcig tu dril ba ni 'di yin te/ de yang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po thun mong ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis yin la/ gnyis pa la/ dag byed a'i stong ra dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar na/ skyabs sems dag byed stong ra gsum/ spyir khrid yig rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/ skyabs yul gyi bla ma ma bsdus par bzhag pa la sems bskyed kyi rjes su/ stong ra'i gsol 'debs byas nas rang la bstim/ de rjes stong ra sgom pa yin/ gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' la gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du/ bla ma sku dngos kho na bsgom/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus su ye nas grub par sgom pa las tshur bstim pa sogs dmigs pa'i spros pa mi dgos/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa kho nas gsol ba drag tu btab/ 'di la sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug pas chog /'gro drug gi dngos su gsol ba 'debs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/

mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /dngos gzhi la gtum mo sgom par 'dod na/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun spyi dang 'dra bar bya ba las/ mig thad ka blta/ lag mthil gyis pus mo mnan no/ /rang nyid rdo rje phag mo rang lus dang bzhugs tshul mthun pa cig bsgom/ /rang gi lus kyi nang stongs sang sang ba/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan ring thung sogs dkyus dang 'dra/ de'i nang lte 'og sor bzhi na raṃ dmar nag nas 'bru tsam/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran chung tsam gyi steng du/ a shad dmar ser ring thung sor gang tsam phra mo zhig bsgom/ de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo yin snyam mos gus dung ba bya/ de nas spyi bor haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba dang*/ steng gi nam mkha' la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dkar zhing zhal 'dzum pa/ gzi brjid 'bar ba zhig bsam/ thun gyi mgor rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud/ de nas rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan drag tu bsgom/ dmigs pa ni/ rlung nyid dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/ raṃ la bus/ de las me lce dmar nag saur bzhir 'bar/ bla ma'i ngo bo lte ba'i a shad la bskul/ a shad las me dmar ser 'ur gyi 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ cung zad zhu/ me lce tshangs bug nas thon te rgya cher 'bar/ me lce'i rtse mo las mchod pa sna tshogs sprul/ bla ma mchod pa bzhi rdzogs kyi mnyes par bsam/ me lce'i 'od las bde drod kyi mchod pa phul/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma de yang byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ me lce dang lhan cig tshur byon/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ bdud rtsi spyi bo'i haṃ yig la 'dres/ thig le'i rgyun nar gyis babs/ mgrin par slebs pas dga' ba bum dbang*/ snying gar slebs pas mchog dga' gsang dbang*/ lte ba'i a shad la thim pas khyad dga'/ sher dbang*/ de las kyang bdud rtsi babs pa raṃ la thim pas/

lhan skyes dang dbang bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dran par bya/ de nas kyang 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa dkyus dang 'dra ba bsgoms pa las/ khyad par ni raṃ gyi me dang a shad kyi me gcig tu 'dres pa 'bar ba dang*/ haṃ gi thig le yang a shad brgyud de raṃ la thim par bsgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di ni gtum mo zas su za ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ste gsum gar dmigs pa gcig la dril ba yin pas/ gnad shin tu che'o/ /yang 'di la gtum mo 'bar ba la sems gtad de/ rlung drag tu bus pa'i phyi 'dzin khong 'dren drag po dang*/ thig le 'bab pa la sems gtad nas drag tu rngubs nas thur sel gyi sgo gnyis la gzir ba dang*/ de thams cad la sems nam mkha' la yal du bcug /lto ba phyir bkyed nas lus gcu zhing rtsal sprugs drag po byed pa dang*/ hal zhes brjod pa ni/ thabs lam gnyis pa'i man ngag rlung sbyor gcig la lam rdzogs pa ste/ 'di nye brgyud bka' gsar pa zhig yin no/ /gtum mo stan gcig stong tshad rang la 'di 'chad pa min/ shin tu gsang ba'o/ /spyir 'di la chos drug ste thog gcig ma zer/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 'di la yang sgos su gtum mo stan thog gcig mar ming 'dogs mdzad/ gzhan sgyu lus sogs re re nas phral ba la de dang de stan thog gcig ma'i tha snyad mi byed do/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid mdun nam spyi bo'am snying gar bsgoms kyang rung*/ gang na bzhugs pa'i phyogs sam mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab kyang rung ste/ pha bla ma pha bla ma/ bla ma rang mkhyen/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes mos gdung drag po snying la 'brab pa zhig bsgoms nas de'i ngang la lhod kyis bzhag /rang lha skur lam tsam gsal btab ste/ rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la dmigs nas/ 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin pa la bzang ngan bde sdug chags sdang mtho dman nyes ring 'byor rgud dga' mi dga' gtam snyan mi snyan sogs la a 'thas kyi zhen pas spang blang dgag sgrub byed pa 'dir a re 'khrul/

gtad pa rang ci yod/ rmi lam lta bu rang yin ang zhes sbyangs nas/ g.yas med du chal song ba de ka la bzo bcos med par bzhag /dbang po rab 'bring gi nyams len thams cad de la 'dus/ de ma thag rang lhar gsal ba'ang*/ tha mal gyi rnam pa gang yin yang rung ste/ nang stong sang ngai ba'i lte 'og tu chos 'byung dang rigs drug sgom pa sogs 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed dkyus dang mthun par bsgom mo/ /'di la dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi gnad so sor tshang ba yin kyang gcig tu dril nas bsgom pa yin pas dmigs skor gcig kho na'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam la bzung ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ yul snang lta ba'o/ dang po ni/ rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad kho na ste/ de yang dmigs pa de tshar gsum tsam re bsdus nas 'jur bar bsgoms pa'i rjes su rang gzhan snod bcud dgra gnyen laungs spyod thams cad la bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs shing*/ de ka'i ngang la gang shar bzo med du 'jog/tshul de lta bu yang yang goms par byed pa yin/ gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ 'dun pa sbyong ba kho na yin te dkyus bzhin yin/ 'on kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa dang*/ rang bzhin dbyings kyi ngang skyong ba de gal che'o/ /gsum pa yul snang ni rang gi snying gar hūm̐ yig dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin zhig bsgom/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'dun pa dang*/ yul snang lta 'dod drag tu bya/ hūm̐ las 'od kyi thag pa lta bu zhig rgyang ste 'phros/ gang lta 'dod pa'i dngos po de zhags pas drangs pa ltar tshur byung nas snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snang ba thams cad khra gsal le gsal ba la sems gtad de bsgom skabs 'dir bum can bsgom pa gal che/ lar ma zin 'byams dang gol sa gsum/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis bcad par bya/ /zhes 'byung la/ rmi lam sgyu lus kyi skabs su gal che bar bzhed/ bzhi pa 'od gsal la/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa dmigs pa'i gtso bo yin pas/

bla ma la brten nas 'dzin pa de nges par bsgom/ de kas zin na legs/ ma zin na rno khyad du a yig la rten nas 'dzin pa yin te/ rang gi dbu ma'i mas snar a dkar po bsgom/ steng rlung nan nan/ 'og rlung then then byas pas/ a de gsang ba'i rtsa bar lhan lhan song*/ gsang ba'i rtsa lam nas kyang gcus kyog kyog pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nor bu'i dbus su kha dog sngon po 'od 'tsher ba zhig tu gyur/ mgo nang bstan du log shugs drag pos phyi la 'gro 'dod kyang bu ga dog po la ma shong bas 'gro mi thub par lhan lhan 'dug pa la yud cig sems drag tu gtad/ yang de ka'i snang ba ma 'gags tsam la had de chad de bzhag /de ltar yang yang bsgom/ 'od gsal 'dzin lugs spyi dang 'dra/ 'dzin pa la lhag par bsngags so/ /'di kho nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin 'ong*/ stan thog gcig ma rang gi 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa de phyi ma 'di kho na yin bla ma la brten pa'i dmigs pa de/ spyi'i khog phub rgyab rten yin gyi/ stan thog gcig ma'i skabs kyi/ dmigs pa rang min no/ /a la brten pa 'di rten bud med kyis sgom na/ lte 'og sor brgyad tsam du dbu ma'i mas snas sleb pa'i mas sna de kar bsgom/ rlung gi gnad sogs gzhan 'dra'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i chos bzhi po de thams cad cha tshang sgom na thog mar re re bzhin zla ba gnyis gsum sbyangs pas nyams myong sna re rnyed 'ong*/ de rjes nyin zhag phrugs gcig nang du bzhi char sgom na/ tho rangs nas snga thun la gtum mo/ gung thung la sgyu lus dgong thun la rmi lam/ srod thun la 'od gsal bsgom zhes khrigs ka 'di bzhin yang mdzad/ 'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /de bzhin du bzhi char bsgom par mi nus na/ gsum sdeb bam/ gnyis sdeb bam/ re re bsgoms pas kyang don khyad par can 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /stan thog gcig ma zhes pa yang rtsa ba'i chos bzhi po la brtsi ba yin te/

'pho ba bar do kha skong bas rgyas bsdus gang bstan kyang 'dra'o gsungs nas go babs lhod yangs su mdzad kyang*/ lag len du 'di ltar mdzad de/ /'pho ba ni/ spyi bo tshangs bug rgya mthongs kha phye ba bzhin du yod par bsgom/ a la brten pa'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa de kho na bzhin las/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i a de rlung phyir 'bud pa dang lhan cig dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ nam mkha'i dbus su mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du song nas nam mkha' dbyings mthon por yal bar bsgom/ yang a de nam mkhar grub mar babs tshangs bug nas zhugs te dbu ma'i mas snar phyin par bsam/ 'di la 'gro 'ong spel ma rang bsgoms pas chog /sgo dgag pa'ang mi dgos gsung ngo*/ /drug pa bar do ni/ rang gi mdun du chos 'byung bsgom pa nas/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa'i bar gzhung khrid kyi dbang po 'bring dang 'dra/ gnad 'chug med kyi dod la/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bzang ngan thams cad la sgyu ma dang*/ bar do'i 'dun pa sbyangs/ mngal sgong gi gnyis sbyor sogs gsal btab nas bar dor zhes pas yi dam yab yum du bsgyur/ de la'ang mngon zhen med par sgyu ma lta ba'o/ /zhes dran par byed pa yin/ yan lag gi chos 'di gnyis kyang nye brgyud kyi cha shas cung zad yin/ de ltar na stan thog gcig mar sdud tshul 'di sngon chad yi ger 'khod pa cher med pa'i zhal rgyun yin/ gtum mo'i rlung sbyor gnyis pa dang*/ yul snang dang*/ a yi 'od gsal dang*/ yan lag gi chos 'di gnyis la dmigs pa'i sde bsgyur ba cung zad re yod pa 'di nye brgyud yin yang gsungs te/ yul snang dang 'od gsal yang yig rnying gis zin pa lags/ gzhan rnams ni man ngag rnying pa kho na'o/ /da ni khrid rgyas 'bring gnyis la dgos pa'i dmigs pa bka' rgya ma rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de la gtum mo'i thon chos byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo dkyus ni/

gtum mo'i nyid kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du song bas/ rang rje btsun ma bzhugs tshul rang lus dang mthun pa'am/ rang lus tha mal du 'jog pa gang yin yang 'dra/ nang stong sang nge ba'i stong ra bca'/ lus gnad tsog pu'am skyil krung gang gis kyang rung*/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbom phra spos dong tsam pa gsungs/ mas sna lte 'og sor bzhi dang*/ yas sna spyi bor zug pa/ spyi bo tshangs bug shin tu yangs pa/ 'phang lo tsam zer te/ dbu ma'i sbom phra dang bstun dbu ma'i kha dang tshangs bug mnyam pa thal le bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad du nyi ma'i gdan rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ rus rgyan dang*/ stag lpags can skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ me'i rang bzhin gang la reg kyang thogs med du/ tshigs 'gro ba zhig bsgom/ yig rnying 'ga' zhig na spyi bor haṃ bsgom pa bshad kyang phyag len du mi mdzad/ de nas rlung ro bsal te sbyor ba bzhi ldan drag tu bsgom/ dmigs pa ni/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung bas bla ma'i sku las me lce 'ur gyi 'bar/ /me lce rtsa dbu ma'i nang du mi shong ba tsam du yar lud par te/ spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon pa na/ me lces nam mkha' khengs/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' dbyings gang ba thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs sprul te phul/ me 'od nyid bde ba'i mchod par gyur/ de thams cad bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ me lce dang lhan cig tshur byon/ bdud rtsi spyi bo tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de/ bla ma'i sku la babs pas lcags sreg la snum blug pa bzhin du sor sgra dang*/ tsheg sgra dang*/ 'ur rgyang dang bcas te/ lus kyi nang thams cad me lce drag pos 'ur 'ur shig shig tu khengs par bsam/ rlung thengs bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa bsgom/ 'dis drod la bogs thon/ rtsa zug rlung zug sel ba la bsngags/

spyir bla ma'i byin rlabs bskul ba yin pas gegs thams cad sel zhing yon tan thams cad skye ba la bsngags so/ /nang rtsa'i stong ra bca' ba zhes bya ba ni/ dang por dbu ma gro sog tsam bsgom/ de nas je sbom je sbom la mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ rta lcag tsam/ je phra je phra la gro sogs tsam 'gro bar bsgom zhing*/ 'jam rlung bzung ba de ka la zhag shas bsgom/ yang dbu ma sbaum phra lag ngar tsam du bskyed cing*/ sba lcag tsam du bsdu ba zhag shas bsgom/ de nas mda' dong tsam du bkyed cing*/ lag ngar tsam du bsdu ba zhag shas bsgom/ de nas lus dang mnyam par bkyed cing*/ mda' dong tsam du bsdu ba bzhag shas bsgom/ de rnams la 'jam rlung bsgom/ de nas dbu ma blos 'khyud tshad du rgya dpangs bkyed cing*/ lus dang mnyam par bsdu ba la bslab/ 'di la bum can drag rlung 'dzin no/ /de nas dbu ma phar bkyed tsa na nam mkha' la yas/ nang du bsdus pa'i skabs rta rnga tsam du song ba la sems gtad/ 'di la rlung sbyor zhi drag nges med du sbyang ngo*/ /'di thog mar sgom na/ rtsa rlung gi gegs mi 'byung ba yin/ bar du sgom na dmigs pa gang la gtad kyang rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs yin/ mthar sgom na 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa nam mkha' lta bu 'char/ rtsa bsgoms pas stong nyid rtogs bya ba de yong ba yin gsungs/ 'on kyang re zhig stong pa'i nyams tsam 'char ba'o/ /gegs rang grol gyi skabs/ smad kun da'i gegs bsal ba'i skabs/ tha ma dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis bsal ces pa la/ thog mar rlung khug pa'i kha re bzung*/ de nas rang gi gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo'i thad du hūm̐ dmar po mgo bo nang du bstan pa/ zhabs kyu phyi'i phyogs la bstan pa zhig bsgom/ yang padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba rdo rje'i rtsa nang na yod cing*/ me tog 'dab ma rgyas pa nor bu'i bu ga'i phyi na yod pa/ rtsa ba ba thag lcags kyu lta bu de hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu la sbrel bar bsgom/

lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma yang khrol le ba bsgom/ lus nywa bzhi bsgrim lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ lce phugs su ldog /mig spyi bor gtad/ lag pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor mgo gzhug ldog /'og nas hūm̐ 'dren drag la ring ba bya/ dmigs pa ni gsang ba'i hūm̐ shugs chen pos gyen la 'ongs pa na/ de'i zhabs kyus padma'i rtsa ba nas then pas me tog rdo rje'i bug la ma shong ste/ rdo rje'i rgyu ma phyi nang slog pa bzhin du song nas/ hūm̐ gis yar then dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi bo'i steng du hūm̐ dang*/ nor bu phyi nang log pa rgyang nge 'dug par bsam/ de'i ring la rlung phyir bzung ngo*/ /'di yang yang bsgoms pas/ gang bas 'dzag pa dang*/ chags pas 'dzag pa dang*/ nad gzhis 'dzag pa dang*/ rmi lam du 'dzag pa ste/ de rnams la shin tu bsngags/ lar 'dzag pa drug kar chod de/ 'on kyang dam sel gyis 'dzag pa la bshags bsdams dang*/ grib kyi 'dzag pa la khrus chog dang*/ gnyis ka'i thun mong du tshogs gtor gal che gsungs/ rmi lam sbyong ba'i skabs/ bdag med ma la brten nas sbyong ba dang*/ yul snang gi skabs bdag med ma la brten pa dang*/ 'od gsal bdag med ma la brten nas 'dzin pa rnams la bdag med ma nyid la yi dam byed na des chog /ma yin na rang skad cig la bdag med mar bskyed la/ oṃ a swāhā/ zhag bdun phrag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum 'bad de bzla/ gtor chung zan ril sha chang gis brgyan pa/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ a a i ī ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ o aṃ a swāhā/ lan bdun bzlas pas phul/ gtor chung de dus med du gtong*/ de lta bu sngon du song nas dmigs pa dngos gzhi bsgom pa'i skabs kyang*/ lha bsgom pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba de ma chag pa dgos/ bum chu gcig la sngags stong tsam bzlas/ des nyin mo yang khrus byed cing nyal khar yang 'khrud/ khyad par yig brgya bzla zhing kha lag 'khru ba yang gal che'o/

/de ltar byas na mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyi stobs yin pas/ dmigs pa 'di rnams rno zhing shin tu myur gsungs/ 'od gsal gyi skabs/ 'jag chen gyis bdag med ma dkar mor bshad/ lar khar sngon gang byas kyang 'dra gsungs/ nyams len gyi rgyun sngon ma nyid ka mdzad do/ /'byams gcod kyi snying po ni/ rmi lam skabs su 'byams la/ mgrin pa dang snying gar rtsa 'khor 'dab ma bzhi pa re bsgom/ kha dog spyi dang mthun/ snying gar hūm̐ dmar po/ mgrin par oṃ dmar po/ oṃ las 'od kyi skud pa dmar po zhig byung*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la lan gsum du dkris te/ thang nge sbring nge bskor te lhag ma yar log /sne mgrin pa'i āḥnyid la 'byar bar bsam hūm̐ la sems gtad de gnyid log pas sel/ 'khrul 'byams la mgrin par sngar bzhin dang*/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan gsal btab/ yang oṃ las 'od zer gyi skud pa byung/ spyi bo'i haṃ la lan gsum du dkris nas slar log skud pa'i sne mgrin pa'i oṃ nyid la 'byar bar bsams nas spyi bo'i haṃ las sems gtad pas 'khrul 'byams sel gsungs te/ 'di zin ma thag 'khrul 'gro ba la bsngags/ ye nas rang mi zin pa'i 'khrul 'byams la/ rtog bcas lam khyer gyi skabs der/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ a nu ta ra/ rlung bum can dang*/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ nyal khar rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas/ a yig nu la thim/ de ta la de ra la/ de oṃ la thim/ oṃ la rig pa gtad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /des 'khrul 'byams sel lo/ /'od gsal gyi skabs su 'khrul 'byams sel ba la spyir 'od gsal 'dzin tshul spyi dang 'dra ste/ dang por dmigs pa gang yang rung ba la brten nas/ rang shugs la 'od gsal zin na legs/ rmi lam las 'od gsal zin pa sna rnyed pa dka' bas/

dmigs pa'i stobs kyis zin pa yin na/ dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun te/ zla ba gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ gsum tshun la 'byung*/ stes dbang gis lan re tsam zin pa la ni nges pa med/ gal te de tsam du 'bad kyang bstar chags su zin pa ma byung na/ spogs chog la brten nas btsan thabs su 'dzin dgos/ de yang dmigs pa gtad res kyis gnyid bde chod chod yang sang sang ba byung na myur du zin no/ /yang gnyid 'thug po la nyams ma bde log log pa dang*/ 'dre gdon bzhin du jir jir gnon pa byung na yang myur du zin yong ba'i rtags yin no/ /'dir zla ba gcig nas gsum gyi bar du dmigs pa bsgom pa la ni rtsol pa cher bya/ do nub zin nam sang nub zin nam mi zin pa e yin snyam pa'i re dogs kyi tsab tsub mi bya bar rtsis btab med par bskyur na/ yang snyam med pa cig la la zin yong ba shas che/ ye ma zin na btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba ni/ da ni zhag 'dun sogs myur du 'dzin par bya snyam pa'i skabs/ bla ma'am mched grogs la tshogs 'khor gyi mchod pa phul/ bshags bsdam bya/ 'od gsal zin par smon lam btab/ de nas bzung nub re bzhin mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang*/ myur mdzad mgon po'i gtor ma bya zhing*/ 'od gsal zin par 'phrin las gzhol/ zhag bdun tsam gyi sngon nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la 'bad cing*/ spyod lam dam rdzas la gzab pa gal che/ de rjes zhag gsum tsam gyi sngon nas nyin mo gnyid ye ma shor bar bya/ mtshan dus kyi gnyid kyang sum cha bzhi cha tsam bri/ dmigs pa dang 'dun pa drag tu bya/ man ngag gzhan gyi lugs kyis rlung bzung na rmi lam yong bas 'od gsal gyi skabs su rlung mi 'dzin gsung yang*/ man ngag 'di'i lugs kyis rmi lam byung yang a'u tsi/ rmi lam 'od gsal du 'gyur 'gro ba la tshegs med/ 'od gsal gyi gzhug la rmi lam byung na grogs yin/ lha skur rang shar bya ba de de nas 'ong gsung*/ /spogs chog gi skabs 'dir rlung bsgom pa gnad du che bar bzhed/

dmigs pa dngos ni snying gar rtsa padma sngon po 'dab bzhi'i rnam pa can gyi lte ba la hūm̐ sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra bzhi gsal 'debs/ thams cad kyang sngon po'o/ /hūm̐ la sems gtad/ shes pa rig stong ngos bzung*/ yang hūṃ las 'od 'phros yi ge bzhi la phog /'od du ltem ltem/ de las 'od 'phros rang lus 'od du ltaim ltaim pa/ de las 'od 'phros snang ba thams cad 'od du ltem ltem par song*/ yang hūm̐ la sems gtad nas rig stong skyong ba sogs de ka 'dra ba lan kha re song ba na/ snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yang hūm̐ la sems gtad/ rang lus 'od du zhu nas yi ge lnga la thim/ yang hūm̐ la sems gtad/ padma dang yi ge bzhi po yang hūm̐ la thim/ de la sems gtad/ hūm̐ yang 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i ngang la rig ge bar mnyam par bzhag/mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe/ hūm̐ la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas ka gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de dag tu ka zin yong ba shas che/ gal te ma zin na zhag bdun pa'i nub mo gtor bsngo spyad sngar bzhin byas la/ thod pa mtshan ldan dum bu gcig pa lngas 'og tu sba gsung yang*/ man ngag gab pa yin/ spyir de yang mi 'gal mod/ don ni thod pa mtshan ldan gnyis rnyed na rab/ ma brnyes na gcig /de yang ma brnyes na/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa gnyis su kha zas bzang dgu la gtor ma re bcos/ 'byor na sha chen cung zad kyis brgyan/ gnyis kar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mgron spyan drangs te gcig 'od gsal zin pa na gtang rag tu 'bul lo byas dar gyis bkab ste sbas la bzhag /cig shos gtor ma bsngos te/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol du mi btang bar de nyid du bzhag/gtor ma gta' mar bzung ba de rang gi sngas mgo'i phyogs su bshams dgos/ gtor bsngo'i skabs su gu gul dang*/ tshil chen gyi dud pa btang ngo*/ /rang nyal ba la grogs dam tshig can nyams myong yod pa de 'dras 'od gsal zin ma zin lta bar 'jug pa sogs go yul spyi dang 'dra mod kyang*/

rgyu mtshan du mas 'grub dka' ba'i phyir lag len du mi mdzad de/ de phyin gtor ma dam rdzas sogs sus kyang ma mthong bar rang gcig pur byed pa gnad che gsung*/ nam 'od gsal zin byung ba na/ gta' mar bzhag pa'i gtor ma de yang nangs par gtang rag gi tshul du bsngo/ 'on kyang de ma thag phyir mi gtong bar zhag gsum nas bdun gyi bar nub re bzhin gtor ma de ka gsos nas bsngos/ mthar skya rengs shar ba'i dus shig khang steng ngam/ dur khrod dam ri rtser btang ngo*/ /'od gsal lan gcig zin pa'i mtshams nas/ sngar gyis 'phros las mtshams dam du bcad nas dmigs pa dang*/ 'dun pa drag pos gzhur te bsgoms na bstar chags su zin 'ong*/ de ka la zhud bsrungs nas zla ba gcig gnyis song na/ cung zad brtan pa thob yong de nas 'byung ba lus 'khrugs byung ba dang*/ grib sogs rkyen gyis bsgyur ba'i skabs ma gtogs/ nub re la lan re tsam re nges par z-in 'ong*/ bde gsal gyi nyams rang cher med pa la dran pas zin tsam de yang yang yong zhing yun yang ring rab skyong thub pa 'ong ba lags/ gnyid 'thug po thams cad la 'od gsal rtag tu zin 'ong ba la ni/ shin tu yun ring goms shing rtse gcig tu sgom dgos pa yin no/ /de yang gsal stong gi 'od gsal tsam dge sbyor thun mong ba yin la/ bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal ni dngos gzhi'o/ /rmi lam 'od gsal gnyis kar kyi thun mong du dmigs pa gtad res kyi gnyid mi phebs na/ rang gi snying gar muṃ smug gnag las 'od zer na bun 'dra ba 'phros te/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab pa yang yang bsgom/ kha zas bcud can bsten/ dal brel ran par bcags pas sel/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal zin ma thag chu nang nas theg pa ltar yer gyis byung nas sad 'ong ste/ de la lus kyi smad kyi cha'i dbus su sems gtad pas sel/ de yang nyin mo dmigs pa de ka yang yang bsgom zhing*/ 'di lta bu gnyid dus kyang yang yang bsgom rgyu yin snyam pa byas/

blo tsab tsob mi bya bar lhod de bzhag /mtshan mo rmi lam 'od gsal zin par rang gi dus kyang sad dogs chen po byas na sad 'ong bas lhod kyis byed pa gal che/ de ltar na sad 'byams ni/ rmi lam zin ma thag dang*/ 'od gsal zin ma thag pa la rtag tu sad 'ong ba'i ming yin/ de lta bu byung na thabs de kas sel/ dmigs pa dang 'dun pa rgyun du sbyangs kyang rmi lam dang 'od gsal zin dus med/ bsgoms ma bsgoms med pa 'dra ba de la 'dir 'khrul 'byams zer/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs sogs man ngag gzhan la lan brtul 'byams su grags/ rmi lam zin ma thag 'khrul 'gro na/ man ngag 'di'i lugs kyi 'khrul 'byams stobs chung ba zer/ /nā ro'i gdams par grags pa rnams na dred 'byams zer/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal la dred 'byams 'di cher mi 'ong*/ rmi lam 'di rang mang bas sel thabs gal che/ nyal khar 'dun pa btang res kyi/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i skabs yin na/ gnyid 'thug por song nas rmi lam mi 'ong*/ 'od gsal gyi skabs yin na gnyid mi phebs/ de la stod 'byams zer/ rmi lam ma byung ba la nyin mo rlung sbyor mang du byas pas ka phan/ gnyid 'thug po ngang rmi lam gyi skabs su 'dzag gegs 'byung ba la bde 'byams zer/ de yang rmi lam du ni chags pa'i rkyen dang*/ bag chags dang*/ gdon rkyen sogs sna tshogs yin/ dngos dang rmi lam gang la'ang de byung tsa na/ rmi lam rtsal yang phal cher nyams 'gro/ skabs 'gar lan re lan gnyis khyad med pa 'dra byung na'ang rim pas nyams 'gro zhing*/ khyad par rmi lam gyi dge sbyor gsal stong bde ba'i lha sku bkrag can de rtsa ba nas 'jig/'od gsal gyi skabs la byung na ni lan re kho nas 'od gsal nyams 'gro/ dam sel dang*/ gdon rkyen dang*/ gang 'dzag gis yin na/ slar bsgoms kyang rgyang tsam sor chud pa dka' bar yod/ gang ltar de thams cad la sel thabs gegs rang grol gyi skabs bzhin no/ /'byams pa zhes pa lan re lan gnyis la mi zer gyi/

yang yang byung bas lang shor chen por sor ba'i ming ngo*/ /'on kyang ma 'byams gong thog ma nas ka gcod pa gal che gsung*/ de dag kyang ngang thung zhing 'dod thag nye ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ rtsis btab med par rtag tu nyams su len pa la nam zhig na 'byams pa thams cad rang shugs kyis chod par 'gyur ro/ /'pho ba'i skabs su 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba la sngon 'gro gzhung 'pho gzhan dang 'dra/ rang gi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la chos 'byung gru gsum nyis rtseg phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba/ de'i dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas rdo rje phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar gtod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭwaṃ ga sku g.yas 'gying zhabs bgrad pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pad nyi dang mi ro mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bsgom/ rang lus tha mal du ka gsal ba'i rkang mthil gnyis dang*/ bshang lam du raṃ yig me'i rang bzhin can gsal btab/ de las me lce 'ur gyis 'bar nas lus thams cad zhu zhing khol/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag gi thod par yang song zhing*/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi zhal rang du'ang gsol bas thugs rgyud bde bas tshim par gyur/ de lta bu lan gsum bsgom/ de nas rang nyid he ru ka yab rkyang du gyur/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma spyi dang 'dra/ lte bar rnam shes kyi ngo bo a dkar po dang*/ gsang gnas su rlung gi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'phro ba zhig gsal btab/ 'jam rlung cung zad bzung*/ rlung phyir bsal ba'i tshe hi ka ring po brjod/ de'i tshe gsang ba'i hūm̐ gi rlung shugs kyis lte ba'i a khyer te/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo nas thon bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba'i sgo nas zhugs/

thugs ka tsam du sleb par mos/ de nas man ngag gi yig rnying rang nas/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa lan gsum bskyar/ de rjes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' dbyings mthon por gshegs pa dang*/ yang mar phebs pa sogs bsgom par bshad kyang*/ lag len la de ltar mi mdzad de/ sngags kyi dmigs pa de lta bu lan bdun sbyor/ re re bzhin rang sems dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ stong pa gsum dbyer med du bsres pa la mnyam par 'jog mthar rang sems dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dbyer med pa bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par song gsang ba'i sgo nas byon/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang bum dbang*/ mgrin pa gang gsang dbang*/ snying ga gang shes rab ye shes/ lte ba gang dbang bzhi pa thob/ rtsa thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang*/ nyams bde bas khyab pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de lta bu yang yang bsgom pa yin/ thun 'jog khar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chos 'byung dang bcas pa 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs te rang nyid la thim/ spyi bo tshangs bug gi sgo yang baṃ yig dmar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ 'od zer 'phro bas bkag par bsam/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba 'di la yig chung gcig yod/ mkha' 'gro ma ni gu las byung ba bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i lugs so zer ba de yin no/ /gzhan 'pho ba bar do spyi bka' rang g-i dmigs pa de ka 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba yin gsung ba grags che/ yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag mtshan gyi 'pho ba la ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod de 'di dang mthun shas che/ mkha' spyod dmar mo'i 'pho ba la 'chug med 'pho ba'i mtshan byang*/ btab pa gcig kyang yod pas 'dzug tshugs ma byung na 'di ngos zin pa dkon par 'ong*/ 'chug med mkha' spyod gsar ba tsho re zhig pha ri la zhog ang*/

yang sgrub bo gang zhig chos 'di la brten pa'i gzhan lus sgom pa yin na/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thams cad la bla ma nyid shes rab dang bcas pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang chen po yum can du bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes pa yang gsung rgyun gcig go /'dir smras pa/ dpa' bo dang bcas rnal 'byor ma dpal bye ba'i gtsug rgyan ni gu ma/ /gang gi zhal bum bdud rtsi'i rgyun de srid 'di'i nyes kun dag byed de/ /skal ldan yongs kyi snying gi gsos gyur 'di 'dra thob pa'ang skal pa bzang*/ /gang phyir 'di la gzhan dring mi 'jog cung zad goms pa'i snang ba'ang thob/ /ces bya'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru/ rin po che 'od kyi phreng ba zhes pa'i man ngag gi gzhung mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa de'i nyams len gyi snying po ni/ man ngag thams cad lus gsum la gnad du bsnun par 'dus pa yin/ de la rnam smin gyi lus ni/ rtsa ba dug gsum gyi bskyed/ rgyu las kyis 'phangs/ rkyen 'byung ba lngas bsgyur ba'o/ /rgyu mtshan des na dngos por 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs rtag tu ldang*/ rgyu'i rjes su 'gro bas rang dbang med/ 'byung ba lnga'i gnod pa phyi snod la brten nas kyang 'byung*/ nang nad dang dgra dang gdon gsum du ldang*/ de yang las dang nyon mongs de dang po yid kyis bskyed/ bar du bag chags kyi tshul gyis bsags/ mthar bde sdug tu rnam par smin pa yin/ sad dus 'di la 'khrul bas rmi lam bag chags kyi lus la yang 'khrul te/ nyon mongs las dang bde sdug ldang*/ de gnyis las 'khrul bas yid lus la yang 'khrul te/ nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal gyi snang ba shar/ yid lus kyi skabs der sngar gyi nyon mongs pa sogs kyis rgyu byas/ de dus kyi gsum pos rkyen byas nas/ yang rnam smin gyi lus bskyed pa sogs 'khor lo 'khor ba ltar 'khyams pa yin/ de la rnam smin gyi lus kyi 'khrul ba dag byed kyi thabs la/

sems 'khrul ba'i dngos kyi gnyen po sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang*/ 'khrul ba de la brten lus kyi rgyu byas pas lus la gnad du bsnun pa zhig dgos so/ /de la 'dun pa rgyun chags dang*/ man ngag btsan thabs gnyis so/ /des na dang po ni/ brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs skyabs gnas thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstim ste/ gsol ba rgyun chad med par btab/ rang lus dang snang ba thams cad bde med sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ /thun mtshams thams cad du yang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa khar phog snar phog tu sbyang*/ de ltar bsgoms kyang nyin par sgyu ma lta bu dang mi rtog pa yang bogs ma thon/ mtshan mo rmi lam yang mi zin na/ gnyis pa man ngag btsan thabs kyis 'dzin pa ni/ nyin mo lung stong du gcer bur mchongs rgyug byed pa la sogs pa nyams nga med pa spyod pa mang po dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la gnad bor ba'i gsol ba btab/ mtshan mo nam smad skyil krung ltag snyes dang*/ tsog pu dang*/ seng ge'i nyal stabs gsum po gang rung byas nas/ rmi lam bsgyur ba'i 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ der rmi lam dam dum zin 'ong*/ gnyid sad pa'i dus na/ shar dang snang dang don byed nus/ / shes nas grol bar byed pa yin/ /rmi lam dang da lta'i snang ba gnyis/ dang por shar tsam gyi gnas skabs dang*/ de'i ngang la gnas nas rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su snang ba dang*/ rang dus nyid nas don byed nus pa ste gsum po'i sgo nas khyad par med/ gnas tshul la cung zad kyang ma grub par yang khyad par med/ sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam 'dun pa drag tu sbyong*/ de ltar nan tan tu bsgoms pas rmi lam zin ni 'ong*/ sbyong ba la ya bag tsha byung na/ da lta'i bden zhen gyi 'gab 'dre 'brangs pa yin pas/ de la 'di snyam du na tsha sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i lus de mal na yod/ 'di ni yid kyi lus yin na 'jigs rgyu sogs ci yod snyam pas gang zin du sbyang*/

cung zad 'byongs nas 'byung bzhi sprul bsgyur la bslab/ rig pa dang rlung dpangs gtod de nyi zla'i steng du 'gro ba dang*/ gting du smad nas rgya mtsho'i gting du 'gro ba dang*/ lha'i gnas sogs nyul/ bde ba can sogs zhing khams blta/ po ṭa la dang ri bo rtse lnga dang lcang lo can du rigs gsum mgon po'i zhal blta gdams ngag zhu/ dgyes rdor bde mchog sogs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod cing dbang dang gdams ngag zhu/ rang gzhan rigs drug snod bcud thams cad yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/ yang thog ma lha skur shar ba de tha mal ba'i lus su log 'gro na/ 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi shugs rjes su 'brang ba yin pas gnyid sad ma thag tu dmigs pa dang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa drag tu bsgom/ dpe'i sgyu ma ni me long gi gzugs brnyan la bstod smad dga' ba med pa bsgom/ don gyi sgyu ma ni shar tsam nyid nas bden med la bzhag /gnyis med sgyu ma lha sku snang stong du shar bar bya/ snang stong bde ba dpe dang bsre/ /de don dang bsre/ de zung 'jug tu bsre ba'o/ /gzhan yang sgyu ma'i dpe gsum gyis mtshon pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ shes rab rnam gsum dang*/ rnam thar gsum dang*/ phyi dang nang gi phar phyin drug dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ ting 'dzin gsum sogs thams cad de ka la tshang*/ rmi lam sogs su gdon gyi cho 'phrul thams cad rang dag la 'gro/ 'gro drug lha skur shar bas bar do dag par the tshom med do/ /gnyis pa ni de ltar nyams su blangs kyang*/ dang por skye dka'/ bar du 'byongs dka'/ tha mar brtan pa thob pa dka' na/ mos gus dang*/ 'dun pa'i gnas sngar gyi de ka'i steng du lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag dgos te/ de yang lus gnad seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ mgrin par padma'i dbus su oṃ dmar po 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra bsgom te/

rmi lam 'dzin pa'am sbyong ba'i 'dun pa drag po sbyang*/ des rmi lam gyi bogs thon par the tshom med/ sad dus kyi snang ba nas rmi lam la 'jug kha ma dang*/ gnyid phri phri ba dang*/ gnyid la hrum gyis song ba dang*/ rmi lam 'char kha ma ste/ dus bzhi po der rlung sems 'du ba'i gnad mgrin pa na yod pa'o/ /de klu sgrub kyi gdams pa yin no/ /yang snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su mar me lta bu 'od dkar la rtse mo dmar ba sor bzhi pa zhig bsgoms la/ de la rig pa bcug cing rlung yang cung zad bsdams/ nyin mtshan du de ltar bsgoms na/ nyin mtshan kyi 'od gsal gnyis kar 'char/ 'od gsal gyi man ngag bsgom bde zhing*/ dmigs pa gsal 'dus zab pa 'di lta bu gzhan la med/ grub thob lwa ba pa'i gdams ngag yin gsung*/ yang smin phrag gnad kyi sgor/ thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ snum la 'dril ba/ che ste mthe bong tsam/ chung na rgya sran tsam nyams bde ba zhig gsal btab/ de la rlung sems drag tu bcug/'di 'od gsal gyi 'dun pa dang sbyar na 'od gsal zin/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa sbyar na rmi lam yang zin pa yin na'ang*/ gtso bor sad dus sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag yin/ gnyid sad dus kyi snang ba/ dpral ba'i 'khor lo dang sbyor ba'i lung khungs yod pa bzhin no/ /'di rnal 'byor ma skal pa bzang mo'i bzhed pa yin no gsung*/ rje btsun rmog lcog pa nyid kyi rnam thar na/ gdams pa 'di gsum bur sgom las brgyud par bshad pas/ de ltar yang yin mod kyi/ mgrin pa'i yi ge la sems gtod pa 'di/ 'od gsal dang rmi lam gyi spogs chog gi skabs na yod pa dang*/ smin mtshams kyi thig le rmi lam gyi dbang gi skabs na yod pas/ mkha' 'gro ni gu ma nyid kyi gdams pa dang 'brel zhing*/ snying ga'i mar me yang thig le la 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang gnad gcig cing*/ lwa ba pa dang ni gu ma gnyis kyang gdams ngag byin rlabs kyi rkang gcig par bshad pas/

ni gu'i chos drug dang ma 'brel ba ma yin no/ /'di yang gtum mo ma gtogs bsre ba sgyu lus kyi gnad kun rdzob pa man ngag gi rkang yongs su tshang ba zhig go /rin chen 'od phreng gi man ngag go /༈ lam dri med 'od phreng las chos drug gi snying po 'di tsam gsungs so/ /sngon 'gro'i skabs gsum la skyabs 'gro logs su ma gsungs kyang kha 'gengs dgos/ sems bskyed spyi dang mtshungs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor logs su byed de/ sgyu lus kyi skabs dang mtshungs pa las/ byang chub kyi sems rtogs pa dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs/ mjug tu bla ma'i skyabs 'gro nam nam ma re mdzad/ dngos gzhi thabs lam la byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo bsgom/ rlung rtar bzhon pa yang 'di ka yin gsung*/ de nas srid pa'i dbang zhu ba yang bsgom te dmigs pa gnyis yod/ sgyu lus la rang lus snang stong lha sku dang*/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed gnyis sbrags te bsgom/ spyir dben pa la bsten/ bla ma'i mos gus kyis rgyab phul/ chos 'di bas skyabs kyi mi dang mi 'grogs spyod lam thams cad rang bzhin med rtogs kyis zin par bya/ chos drug rgyas pa'i skabs/ deng sang sgyu lus sgos kyi dbang bkar grags shing gab bsgyur dgos rgyu de ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul gyis len/ gdams ngag 'di'i dbang du byas na/ bsre ba sgyu lus spyi'i tshar gsum khug pa yin gsung*/ lar gtum mo'i dbang yin/ khrid 'di 'bogs na/ gtum mo'i dbang 'di ka sgo 'byed kyi dbang du bskur ba yin par bshad do/ /rmi lam 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gsum yod/ dmigs pa dang po ni/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ /gsang bar phaṭa dmar skya/ haṃ las thig le chad bde mchog dkar po 'gyur/ phaṭa las thig le chad pas rje btsun mar gyur te/ kha sbyor du zhugs pas lus sems bde bas khyab/ mdun du'ang de lta bu bsgom/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa sbyangs/

mtshan mo gnyid du 'gro khar mdun gyi de rang nyid kyi snying ga'i lhan skyes la thim/ de yang 'od du lam pa la mtha' nas yal mi dmigs bar bzhag/dmigs pa gnyis pa rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad rang yin/ dmigs pa gsum pa rtog med la bzung ba gnyis kyi bla ma la brten pa de yin/ sbyangs pa ni/ 'dun pas sbyang ba la mdzad de/ spel sprul sgyur gsum yang de ka'i ngang nas byed/ yul snang gi dmigs pa yang stan thog gcig ma'i skabs su bshad pa de bsgom/ gnyis kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i man ngag bla ma la brten nas 'od gsal 'dzin pa de kho na len par mdzad/ des rtsa ba'i chos bzhi'i don gyi snying po tshang*/ 'pho ba bar do'i dmigs pa logs su mi dgos/ 'dod na khrid rgyas par 'byung ba bzhin no/ /nyams len gyi tshul 'di la brten pa'i sgom chen pa la dgos pa'i go don mang po yod pa rnams ni/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa nyid kyi bka' las shes par bya'o/ /༈ yang nyams myong yon tan rgya mtsho las 'byung ba'i man ngag ni/ gang zag 'ga' zhig lus ngag gi rtsol pa zhan pas/ thabs lam sgom par mi nus pa'am blo rigs kyis bsgom par mi spro na'ang*/ gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim nyams len la kha 'chad pa med de/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gsum gyis lam thams cad cha tshang la ma nor ba yin gsung*/ de yang dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams shes pas nyams len la 'dun pa bskyed/ gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad zab pa dang rgya che ba zung 'jug tu go /de ltar ma rtog pa'i sems can la sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang 'brel ba byed/ dngos gzhi la dang po sgyu lus dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi/ rab ni mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer nyid yin pa las/ bla ma'i bzhugs gdan pad zla kho na dang*/ bla ma sku dngos yin pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa bskyed/ gsol 'debs kyi skabs sgyu ma la sgyu mar ngo shes pa dang*/

rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa gsung ba yod kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas don gcig pa'i phyir/ gzhung khrid ltar byas pas chog gsung*/ dbang po 'bring ni rang lus snang stong lha sku nyid yin pa las/ snang ba thams cad kyi steng du 'dun pa zhar byung du sbyong*/ snang cha bskyed rim/ stong cha rdzogs rim/ dbyer med bde ba chen por ngo sprad/ tha ma ni 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed yin/ chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dang*/ skabs 'dir sgyu ma'i 'dun pa kho na las 'dun pa gzhan gyi spros pa mi byed do/ /rmi lam la nyin par sgyu ma rmi lam gyi 'dun pa nyid dang*/ mtshan mo rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnas dang*/ rtog bcas la bzung ba gnyis sbrags te bsgom/ de la cung zad brtan pa thob na/ 'dun pas sbyong ba nyid bsnan te/ gang zin dpag tu med par sprul pa la sogs pa zin sbyong sprul bsgyur thams cad cha mnyam rang shugs su 'byung*/ yul snang ni thig le la brten pa de bsgom te/ thig le'i 'od kyis gang lta ba'i yul tshur drangs rang gi snying gar thim par bsgom pa de khyad par ro/ /yang mtshan mo nyal khar blta ba'i yul dang*/ snying ga'i thig le gnyis 'od kyi thag pas sbrel/ yang sogs kun la sgyu ma ltar bsgom/ skabs 'dir bsre 'pho shes rab rnam bzhi'i sgo nas cung zad tsam ngo sprod bya/ de nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa ni/ a yig la brten pa yin te/ 'di'i khrid yig gi dkyus la/ rang gi lte 'og sor bzhi bcal bar zhes pa yod kyang de'i mchan bu rang mchan na/ dbang po'i rtse mo'am gsung ba yod de/ rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i gnad dam pa yin/ stan thog gcig ma'i de ka la dgongs par mngon/ dngos bstan a dkar po gcig nor bur bsgom pa'o/ /'od gsal bde stong las snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba ni/ 'od gsal las lha sku rang shar 'byung ba'i gnad yin par bshad do/

/rgyas par 'gro mgon sangs rgyas nyid kyi gsung du blta'o/ /de dag las rin chen 'od phreng gzhung gi tshul du mdzad pas gleng brjod gang yang med/ lam dri med 'od phreng dang 'di gnyis la khrid logs pa mi byed de/ chos drug las gzhan du med pas so zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ngag sgros la sngon chos drug khrigs chags 'di/ ye ge 'god pa bka' rgya ma grol pa'i skabs/ brjed tho ltar bur khrid yig bsdus pa 'dra min mdzad pa yin gsung pa sogs yod kyang*/ chos drug rang spyir snyan brgyud kyi bka' rgya ma grol pa'i skabs yin na ni/ dam dum yi ge bris kyang bka' rgya la gnod pa dang*/ 'dra min bris na brjed thor shin tu mi rung ste/ dkyus de brjes pa'i rgyur ngos 'gyur bas de 'dra ni ma yin no/ /des na 'di gnyis 'gro mgon sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin pas bka' rgya grol pa yin/ dmigs pa 'dra min phran bu yod pa rnams 'dam kha yin par shes par bya dgos/ des na 'di gnyis ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i snod du gyur pa la/ gdams skor yongs rdzogs rang mi dgos pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis don du gnang*/ de rnams la yang nyams rtogs khyad par can mthar phyin skyes pa yin 'dug/khrid chen mo'i nang du don 'dus su chug kyang logs su byed pa mi 'gal te/ sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma bzhin no/ /des na mkhas grub chen po khyung po pa sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma logs su phral nas mdzad pa bzhin du/ /'gro mgon ston pas kyang 'di gnyis mdzad pa yin te/ skabs 'dir mdzad pa po bzang ngan la khyad med par go dgos so/ /rin chen 'od phreng dang 'di gnyis la tshig bcad lhug gi khyad la rtog dpyod zhugs ma zhugs kyi stabs cig byung 'dug pa ma gtogs dgos don de dag la khyad med do/ /de ltar na khrid tshul rgyas pa'i nang nas dmigs pa'i gtso bo ji ltar 'os pa gud du phyung ba yin du chug kyang*/

skyes mchog de dag gis khrid kyi rnam grangs so sor byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa yin pas/ da ltar yang gdul bya so so'i blo rigs dang bstun nas khrid tshul 'di dag gis slob ma bkri ba yang shin tu legs shing 'os pa nyid do/ /spyir yang tshig khrid la gsung gi rgyun rgyas pa nyid tshig gi bslad ma zhugs shing*/ lhag chad nor 'khrul med pa zhig bla ma las thos shing blo la zin pa zhig dgos mod/ don nyams myong gi khrid la khrid yig rgyas pa'i gral bsgrigs de ka mu ded rang du dgos pa ma yin te/ dmigs pa re re'am gnyis gsum la brten nas nyams myong tshad du phebs pa byung na/ des thams cad kyi rkang zin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang ci ste na/ chos drug gi gzhung khrid rgyas bsdus rnams ni bsgom par mi spro la/ ni gu'i chos drug gi ming dang ldan pa mos na/ 'di gnyis kyi snga ma la 'pho ba bar do tsam bsnan pa dang*/ rin chen 'od phreng dang*/ phyi ma 'di la de'i steng du gtum mo yang ji ltar 'os pa bsnan cing*/ snon tshul yang dkyus la bcug na grub thob gsung la bsre bslad du 'gyur nyen srid pas/ logs su bsnan na legs par 'gyur ro/ /de las gzhan du ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig yin zer ba/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos nye bar sbyar ba lta bu/ ni gu mas ma gsungs/ khyung pos ma thos/ brgyud pa'i bla ma sus kyang ma dgongs pa'i bcos ma ni gu'i chos zhes pa'i ming tsam la rgyug cing chos rgyus med pa'i blun po 'brid byed tsam du zad do/ /ci ste chos tshul gzhan las bshad pa'i dmigs rim rnam dag yin no zhe na/ de la ni gu'i chos kyi ming btags pas ci zhig bya/ shangs pa'i bka' brgyud kyi lugs kyi dmigs pa sna cig tsam yang med pa la shangs chos kyi ming btags pa de 'dras c-ir yang mi rung ngo*/ /sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma zhes bya ba ni/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po'i gsung them yig las/

sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma la/ gsol 'debs bzhi la 'dun pa brgyad/ gsol 'debs bzhi ni dbang po tha ma'i skabs bzhin yin/ 'dun pa brgyad ni 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ bla ma'i mos gus/ gnyid du song bar shes pa/ sgyu ma rmi lam du shes pa/ sbyong spel sbrul bsgyur rnams yin par gsungs/ nyams len gyi rim pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dag byed stong ra rnams sngon du btang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skyo shas drag tu bskyed pa la dkyus las nan tan che tsam bya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni sgyu lus dkyus dang 'dra/ bla ma rang la bstim pa'i rjes su rang lha skur gsal ba dang*/ phyi snang ba thams cad la yang sems gtad de/ gang gsal thebs thebs su lha skur gsal btab thams cad la cig car dmigs nas/ 'di thams cad rang gi sems snang yin la/ sems de yang bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ de las kyang khyad par du nga gnyid du song 'dug /snang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam rang yin ang snyam bden med kyi 'dun pa dang*/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa gnyis spel gyin drag tu sbyangs/ thun mtshams su'ang 'dun pa gsum sbrags g.yel med du bsgom zhing*/ lhag par yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bsnan/ nyal khar yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang*/ bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs nas/ de ka'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag gzhan mi 'tshal/ 'di kho nas chog par bzhed/ de rjes sbyang ba spel ba sprul ba bsgyur ba rnams chos drug rgyas pa bzhin bstan no/ /rgyas par na 'di la mkhas grub rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi khrid yig kyang logs su yod pa blta bar bya la/ gzhung khrid la nges po yod phyin/ yi ge 'di tsam gyis kyang don mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na/ chos drug gzhung khrid kyi skabs su dgos pa'i dmigs pa bka' rgya ma'i rigs dang*/ gdams ngag nyer mkho rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa'i sde rnams bshad zin to/

/'dir smras pa/ zab don 'khrul med 'di yin zhes/ /nges tig smra ba shin tu dkon/ /mi gra gshog phyir thob chos tsam/ /'ol gcod byed pas rgyal khams gang*/ /mi phal blun po phyogs mos kyis/ /chos 'dir 'jug pa phal che ba/ /ja ngo nya ma shas che bas/ /zab don go ba dkon mod kyi/ khog ngan blo skyon chags pa'ang nyung*/ /che 'dod chos brgyad phyogs 'dzin gsum/ /gcig las gcig che 'gran pa bzhin/ /dang po go rtogs snying rje gsum/ /gcig las gcig chung 'gran pa bzhin/ /de ltar khyad chos drug ldan pa'i/ /dge bshes ming can zam zom 'ga'/ /rang gis bslabs pa'i kha bshad tsho/ /skye bo phal la ma brin pas/ /nyag nyog 'khor du 'du re nas/ /chos rgyus med pa'i tshogs pa la/ /lung skyog rnams su chos 'di 'chad/ /chos tshul 'di la sbyangs pa yi/ /shes ldan rnams la ston nyan med/ /a po cang gi klog dar gyi/ /dpe de thugs su chud par mdzod/ /he rang re skal ldan yin par nges/ /zab chos nges tig yod sar sleb/ /bla ma sbed kyang mi dgos par/ /chos la spyod pa e ma ho/ /zab lam ni gu chos drug gzhung khrid ma mo'i lhan thabs 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras ba'o// //maṅga lam//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zab lam ni gu chos drug gi gzhug khrid ma mo'i lhan thabs kha skong bzhugs/ - PAGE 328 -- PAGE 357 -- PAGE 327 -
